# Define filters
year = filters.get("year")
month = filters.get("month")
employee = filters.get("employee")
company = filters.get("company")
branch = filters.get("branch")
division = filters.get("division")
department = filters.get("department")

# Construct conditions
conditions = []
if employee:
    conditions.append(f"e.name = '{employee}'")
if company:
    conditions.append(f"e.company = '{company}'")
if branch:
    conditions.append(f"e.branch = '{branch}'")
if division:
    conditions.append(f"e.custom_division = '{division}'")
if department:
    conditions.append(f"e.department = '{department}'")

# Get date range for the given month
month_days = {
    "Jan": {"from_date": "12-31", "to_date": "02-01"},
    "Feb": {"from_date": "01-31", "to_date": "03-01"},
    "Mar": {"from_date": "02-28", "to_date": "04-01"},
    "Apr": {"from_date": "03-31", "to_date": "05-01"},
    "May": {"from_date": "04-30", "to_date": "06-01"},
    "Jun": {"from_date": "05-31", "to_date": "07-01"},
    "Jul": {"from_date": "06-30", "to_date": "08-01"},
    "Aug": {"from_date": "07-31", "to_date": "09-01"},
    "Sep": {"from_date": "08-31", "to_date": "10-01"},
    "Oct": {"from_date": "09-30", "to_date": "11-01"},
    "Nov": {"from_date": "10-31", "to_date": "12-01"},
    "Dec": {"from_date": "11-30", "to_date": "01-01"}
}

fr_date = ""
t_date = ""
if month and year:
    if month in month_days:
        if month != "Dec":
            fr_date = str(year) + "-" + month_days[month]["from_date"] + " " + "00:00:00"
            t_date = str(year) + "-" + month_days[month]["to_date"] + " " + "23:59:59"
            first_day_next_month = str(year) + "-" + month_days[month]["to_date"]
            first_day_last_month = str(year) + "-" + month_days[month]["from_date"]
        else:    
            next_year = int(year) + 1
            fr_date = str(year) + "-" + month_days[month]["from_date"] + " " + "00:00:00"
            t_date = str(next_year) + "-" + month_days[month]["to_date"] + " " + "23:59:59"
            first_day_next_month = str(next_year) + "-" + month_days[month]["to_date"]
            first_day_last_month = str(year) + "-" + month_days[month]["from_date"]

# Consolidated SQL Query
sql_query = f"""
    SELECT
        e.name AS employee,
        e.employee_name,
        e.holiday_list,
        DATE(ec.time) AS date,
        TIME(ec.time) AS in_time,
        LEAD(TIME(ec.time)) OVER (PARTITION BY e.name, DATE(ec.time) ORDER BY ec.time) AS out_time,
        st.start_time AS shift_start_time,
        st.end_time AS shift_end_time,
        st.custom_actual_start_time,
        ec.shift,
        ec.device_id AS in_device,
        LEAD(ec.device_id) OVER (PARTITION BY e.name, DATE(ec.time) ORDER BY ec.time) AS out_device,
        ec.custom_area AS in_area,
        LEAD(ec.custom_area) OVER (PARTITION BY e.name, DATE(ec.time) ORDER BY ec.time) AS out_area,
        e.grade,  -- Added grade
        ec.custom_is_temporary_shift,
        ec.custom_cross_days,
        e.default_shift,
        st.custom_end_across_days AS custom_end_across_days
    FROM
        `tabEmployee` AS e
    LEFT JOIN
        `tabEmployee Checkin` AS ec ON e.name = ec.employee
    LEFT JOIN
        `tabShift Type` AS st ON st.name = ec.shift
    WHERE
        1=1
        {f"AND e.name = '{employee}'" if employee else ""}
        {f"AND e.company = '{company}'" if company else ""}
        {f"AND e.branch = '{branch}'" if branch else ""}
        {f"AND e.custom_division = '{division}'" if division else ""}
        {f"AND e.department = '{department}'" if department else ""}
        AND ec.time BETWEEN '{fr_date}' AND '{t_date}'
    ORDER BY
        e.name, ec.time
"""
# Execute the SQL query
result = frappe.db.sql(sql_query, as_dict=True)

# Process result to calculate attendance, worked hours, etc.
processed_result = []
consecutive_late_entries = {}
full_day = frappe.utils.get_time("08:00:00")
half_day = frappe.utils.get_time("04:00:00")

for data in result:
    # Skip if both in_time and out_time are None
    if not data["in_time"] and not data["out_time"]:
        continue

    # Initialize attendance
    if not data["in_time"] and data["out_time"]:
        data["attendance"] = "Missing In"
    elif not data["out_time"] and data["in_time"]:
        data["attendance"] = "Missing Out"
    elif data["out_time"] < data["in_time"] and data["custom_end_across_days"] != 1:
        data["attendance"] = "Invalid Punch"
    else:
        # Calculate worked hours
        hours = data["out_time"] - data["in_time"] if data["out_time"] > data["in_time"] else data["out_time"] + frappe.utils.get_timedelta("24:00:00") - data["in_time"]
        data["worked_hours"] = hours

        if frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= full_day:
            data["attendance"] = "Present"
        elif full_day >= frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= half_day:
            data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
        else:
            data["attendance"] = "Absent"

    # Handling late entry
    if data["shift_start_time"] and data["in_time"]:
        late_entry_diff = data["in_time"] - data["custom_actual_start_time"]
        if late_entry_diff and late_entry_diff < frappe.utils.get_timedelta("00:00:59"):
            data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
            consecutive_late_entries[data["employee"]] = consecutive_late_entries.get(data["employee"], 0) + 1
            if consecutive_late_entries[data["employee"]] > 3:
                data["attendance"] = "Absent"
        else:
            data["late_entry"] = "No"

    # Handling early exit
    if data["shift_end_time"] and data["out_time"]:
        early_exit_diff = data["shift_end_time"] - data["out_time"]
        if early_exit_diff > frappe.utils.get_timedelta("00:00:59"):
            data["early_exit"] = "Yes"
        else:
            data["early_exit"] = "No"

    # Handling area change
    if data["in_area"] != data["out_area"]:
        data["area_change"] = "Yes"
    else:
        data["area_change"] = "No"

    processed_result.append(data)

# Return the final columns and data
columns = [
    {"fieldname": "employee", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Employee", "label": "Employee Code", "width": "160px"},
    {"fieldname": "employee_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Employee Name", "width": "160px"},
    {"fieldname": "date", "fieldtype": "Date", "label": "Date", "width": "160px"},
    {"fieldname": "in_time", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "In Time", "width": "160px"},
    {"fieldname": "out_time", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Out Time", "width": "160px"},
    {"fieldname": "shift", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Shift Type", "label": "Shift", "width": "60px"},
    {"fieldname": "grade", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Grade", "width": "60px"},
    {"fieldname": "shift_start_time", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Shift Start Time", "width": "100px"},
    {"fieldname": "shift_end_time", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Shift End Time", "width": "100px"},
    {"fieldname": "custom_is_temporary_shift", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Temporary Shift", "width": "60px"},
    {"fieldname": "attendance", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Attendance", "width": "160px"},
    {"fieldname": "worked_hours", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Worked Hours", "width": "100px"},
    {"fieldname": "late_entry", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Late Entry", "width": "160px"},
    {"fieldname": "early_exit", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Early Exit", "width": "160px"},
    {"fieldname": "area_change", "fieldtype": "Data", "label": "Area Change", "width": "160px"},
]


data = columns, processed_result

def mark_attendance(data, first_day_next_month, first_day_last_month):
    """Mark attendance and other status checks."""
    
    # Check if the employee's check-in and check-out times are valid and calculate attendance
    if not data.get("in_time") or not data.get("out_time"):
        data["attendance"] = "Absent"
    else:
        # Time calculations for late/early entries
        late_entry = calculate_late_entry(data)
        early_exit = calculate_early_exit(data)

        if late_entry:
            data["attendance"] = "Late"
            data["late_entry"] = late_entry
        elif early_exit:
            data["attendance"] = "Early Exit"
            data["early_exit"] = early_exit
        else:
            data["attendance"] = "Present"
        
    return data


def calculate_late_entry(data):
    """Calculate the late entry based on shift timings."""
    shift_start_time = data.get("shift_start_time")
    in_time = data.get("in_time")

    if shift_start_time and in_time:
        shift_start = datetime.strptime(shift_start_time, "%H:%M")
        in_time = datetime.strptime(in_time, "%H:%M")
        late_entry = in_time - shift_start
        if late_entry > timedelta(minutes=15):
            return late_entry
    return None


def calculate_early_exit(data):
    """Calculate early exit based on shift timings."""
    shift_end_time = data.get("shift_end_time")
    out_time = data.get("out_time")

    if shift_end_time and out_time:
        shift_end = datetime.strptime(shift_end_time, "%H:%M")
        out_time = datetime.strptime(out_time, "%H:%M")
        early_exit = shift_end - out_time
        if early_exit > timedelta(minutes=15):
            return early_exit
    return None


def process_shift_data(data):
    """Process additional shift-related data like area change and worked hours."""
    # Calculate worked hours and check for any area changes
    if data.get("in_time") and data.get("out_time"):
        in_time = datetime.strptime(data.get("in_time"), "%H:%M")
        out_time = datetime.strptime(data.get("out_time"), "%H:%M")
        worked_hours = out_time - in_time
        data["worked_hours"] = str(worked_hours).split(".")[0]  # Format worked hours

    if data.get("in_area") != data.get("out_area"):
        data["area_change"] = "Yes"
    else:
        data["area_change"] = "No"

    return data

            t_date = f"{next_year}-{month_days[month]['to_date']} 23:59:59"
            first_day_next_month = f"{next_year}-{month_days[month]['to_date']}"

    SELECT DISTINCT name, employee_name FROM `tabEmployee`
    WHERE status = 'Active'
""", as_dict=True)

result = []

for emp in employee_list:
    sql = frappe.db.sql(f"""
        SELECT
            e.name AS employee, e.employee_name, e.holiday_list, DATE(ec.time) AS date,
            (CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'IN' THEN TIME(ec.time) END) AS in_time,
            (CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'OUT' THEN TIME(ec.time) END) AS out_time,
            MIN(CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'IN' THEN ec.time END) AS in_date_time,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'OUT' THEN ec.time END) AS out_date_time,
            TIME(st.start_time) AS shift_start_time,
            TIME(st.end_time) AS shift_end_time,
            TIME(st.custom_actual_start_time) AS custom_actual_start_time,
            ec.shift, 
            (CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'IN' THEN ec.device_id END) AS in_device,
            (CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'OUT' THEN ec.device_id END) AS out_device,
            (CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'IN' THEN ec.custom_area END) AS in_area,
            (CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'OUT' THEN ec.custom_area END) AS out_area,
            e.grade, 
            CASE WHEN st.custom_end_across_days = 1 THEN st.custom_end_across_days ELSE 0 END AS custom_end_across_days,
            CASE WHEN ec.custom_is_temporary_shift = 1 THEN "Yes" ELSE "No" END AS custom_is_temporary_shift,
            ec.custom_cross_days, ec.creation
        FROM `tabEmployee` AS e
        LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee Checkin` AS ec ON e.name = ec.employee
        LEFT JOIN `tabShift Type` AS st ON st.name = ec.shift
        LEFT JOIN `tabShift Assignment` AS sa ON sa.employee = e.name

        AND e.name = '{emp["name"]}'

        AND eg.custom_no_punch_applicable = 0

        # If leave_id is missing, skip safely
        if not leave_id:
            continue

        existing_credit = split_leave_dict.get(leave_id, 0)
        new_credit = existing_credit + credit
        split_leave_dict[leave_id] = new_credit

    for emp in employee_data[employee_code]:
        result.append(emp)
        last_emp_index = len(result) - 1

        total_debit = 0  # ✅ ALWAYS define first

        if filters.get("show_details") == 1:
            total_credit = emp["credit"]
            for i, rec in enumerate(split_leave_applications):
                if rec["mark_utilsed"] == 0 and total_debit < total_credit:
                    if (
                        result[-1].get("leave_id")
                        and rec["leave_id"] == result[-1]["leave_id"]
                    ):
                        last_row = result[-1]

                        prev_credit = float(last_row.get("credit", 0))
                        curr_credit = float(rec.get("credit", 0))

                        last_row["credit"] = prev_credit + curr_credit

                        result[-1] = last_row

                    else:
                        result.append(rec)

                    rec["mark_utilsed"] = 1
                    total_debit = total_debit + rec["debit"]

        emp["utilised"] = total_debit
        emp["balance_credit"] = emp["credit"] - emp["utilised"]
        result[last_emp_index] = emp

                early_exit_difference_seconds = early_exit_difference.total_seconds()
                f_seconds = fifteen_minutes_out.hour * 3600 + fifteen_minutes_out.minute * 60 + fifteen_minutes_out.second
                if early_exit_difference_seconds > f_seconds :
                    data["early_exit"] = "Yes"
                else:
                    data["early_exit"] = "No"
        
            """Checking in area and out area"""
            if data["in_area"] and data["out_area"]:
                if data["in_area"] != data["out_area"]:
                    data["area_change"] = "Yes"
                if data["in_area"] == data["out_area"]:
                    data["area_change"] = "No"
            
            if str(data["date"]) != first_day_next_month and str(data["date"]) != first_day_last_month:
                result.append(data)
                # frappe.log_error(title="final_data", message=data)
    
filtered_result = []

for i in result:
    if i.get("in_time") is None and i.get("out_time") is None:
        continue
    elif i.get("attendance") == "Missing In and Out":
        continue
    else:
        filtered_result.append(i)

for idx, i in enumerate(filtered_result):
    if idx == len(filtered_result) - 1:
        if filtered_result[idx-1]["date"] != filtered_result[idx]["date"]:
            filtered_result.remove(i)
        
data = columns, filtered_result

            if data.get("out_time"):

            """ Fetching grade wise Present, Absent, HalfDay, late entry and early chekout Threshold """

                late_count_threshold = grade_emp.custom_allowed_late_count_days or 0
            
            
            """SHIFT START TIME AND END TIME FULL DAY HALF DAY ABSENT THRESHOLD"""
            
            st = None
            et = None

                half_day = frappe.utils.get_time(shift.custom_working_hours_threshold_for_half_day)

                st = shift.start_time
                et = shift.end_time
            
            
            #st = frappe.db.get_value("Shift Type", data["shift"], "start_time")
            #et = frappe.db.get_value("Shift Type", data["shift"], "end_time")
            data["shift_start_time"] = st
            data["shift_end_time"] = et
            shift_type = ""
            if data["shift"]:
                shift_type = frappe.get_doc("Shift Type", data["shift"])
            
            """ Handling across days shifts / night shift """
            
            
        
                    
            """ Marking Attendance and Checkin """
            
            hours = frappe.utils.get_timedelta("00:00:00")
            try:    
                if data["out_time"] is None and data["in_time"] is None:
                    data["attendance"] = "Missing In and Out"
                elif data["in_time"] is None and data["out_time"]:
                    data["attendance"] = "Missing In"
                elif data["out_time"] is None and data["in_time"]:
                    data["attendance"] = "Missing Out"
                elif data["out_time"] is None:
                    data["attendance"] = "Missing Out"
                elif data["out_time"] < data.get("in_time") and data["custom_end_across_days"] != 1:
                    data["attendance"] = "Invalid Punch"
                elif data["out_time"] > data["in_time"]:
                    hours = data["out_time"] - data["in_time"]
                    data["worked_hours"] = hours
                    if frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= full_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Present"
                    elif full_day >= frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= half_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                    elif frappe.utils.get_time(hours) < half_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Absent"
                        
                elif data["out_time"] < data["in_time"] and data["custom_end_across_days"] == 1:
                    twenty_four_hour = frappe.utils.get_timedelta("24:00:00")
                    hours = data["out_time"] + twenty_four_hour - data["in_time"]
                    data["worked_hours"] = hours
                    if frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= full_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Present"
                    elif full_day >= frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= half_day:
                        
                        #frappe.log_error('data["date"]', data["date"])    
                        data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                    elif frappe.utils.get_time(hours) < half_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Absent"
            except Exception as e:
                msg=e
                #frappe.log_error("Biometric Attendance Summary", msg)
                data["attendance"] = "Invalid Punch"
            
            """ Fetching week off and holidays """
            
            holiday_sql = frappe.db.sql(f"""
                SELECT
                    (CASE WHEN h.weekly_off = 0 THEN "HO" ELSE "WO" END) AS holiday,
                    -- (CASE WHEN h.weekly_off = 1 THEN "HO" ELSE 0 END) AS w_off,
                    h.holiday_date
                FROM
                    `tabHoliday List` hl
                LEFT JOIN
                    `tabHoliday` h ON hl.name = h.parent
                WHERE
                    hl.name = '{data.get("holiday_list")}'
                    AND h.holiday_date = '{data.get("date")}'
                GROUP BY
                    h.holiday_date
            """, as_dict = True)
                    
            
            if holiday_sql:
                for h in holiday_sql:
                    try:
                        if str(h["holiday_date"]) == str(data.get("date")) and h["holiday"]:
                            
                            if data.get("attendance") == "Present" and h["holiday"] == "HO":
                                data["attendance"] = "POH"
                            elif data.get("attendance") == "Present" and h["holiday"] == "WO":
                                data["attendance"] = "POW"
                            #else:
                             #   status[str(h["holiday_date"])] = h["holiday"]
                    except Exception as e:
                        msg = e
                    
            """ Marking Late Chekin """
            #if data.get("in_time") and data.get("out_time"):
            if not data.get("attendance") in ("POH", "POW", "Not Present", "Half Day"):
                if data.get("date") not in late_list:

                    if data["shift_start_time"] and data["in_time"]:

                            late_entry_difference = data["in_time"] - data["custom_actual_start_time"]

                            f_seconds = fifteen_minutes_in.hour * 3600 + fifteen_minutes_in.minute * 60 + fifteen_minutes_in.second
                            
                            
                            if 0 < late_entry_difference_seconds < f_seconds :
                                #frappe.log_error("yes1", {"late_count": late_count, "len": len(consecutive_late_entries), "in": data["in_time"], "format_date": data["date"], "data": data})
                                data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                                employee = str(data["employee"]) + str(data["date"]) 
                                date = data["date"]
                                
                                if employee not in consecutive_late_entries:
                                    
                                    if not data.get("attendance") in ("Absent", "Missing In", "Missing Out", "Missing In and Out") or data.get("attendance") == "POH" or data.get("attendance") == "POW":
                                        consecutive_late_entries[employee] = consecutive_late_entries.get(employee, 0) + 1
                                        """if str(data["date"]) == "2024-08-06":
                                            #frappe.log_error("yes", frappe.utils.format_time(data["in_time"], "HH:mm"))"""
                                    #consecutive_late_entries[date] = consecutive_late_entries.get(date, 0) + 1
                                    if len(consecutive_late_entries) > late_count:
                                        if absent > frappe.utils.get_time(hours) > frappe.utils.get_time("00:00:00"):
                                            data["attendance"] = "Absent"
                                        elif data["out_time"] is None and data["in_time"]:
                                            data["attendance"] = "Missing Out"
                                        else:
                                            data["attendance"] = "Half Day"

                            elif late_entry_difference_seconds > f_seconds:
                                if data.get("attendance") not in ("Absent", "Missing Out", "Missing In", "Missing In and Out", "Invalid Punch", "None", None): 
                                
                                    if data["in_time"] and data["out_time"]:
                                        data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                                        data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                                    if frappe.utils.get_timedelta("00:00:00") < hours < frappe.utils.get_timedelta(str(absent)):
                                        data["attendance"] = "Absent"
                                        data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                                
                                #elif data["in_time"]:
                                #    data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                                    
                            else:
                                data["late_entry"] = "No"
                                #consecutive_late_entries[data["employee"]] = 0
                late_list.append(data['date'])
                
            
            """ Marking Early Checkout """
            
            if data["shift_end_time"] and data["out_time"]:
                early_exit_difference = data["shift_end_time"] - data["out_time"]
                early_exit_difference_seconds = early_exit_difference.total_seconds()
                f_seconds = fifteen_minutes_out.hour * 3600 + fifteen_minutes_out.minute * 60 + fifteen_minutes_out.second
                if early_exit_difference_seconds > f_seconds :
                    data["early_exit"] = "Yes"
                else:
                    data["early_exit"] = "No"
        
            """Checking in area and out area"""
            if data["in_area"] and data["out_area"]:

                if data["in_area"] == data["out_area"]:

                    data["out_time"] = sql[index+1]["out_time"]
                    data["out_area"] = sql[index+1]["out_area"]
                    data["out_device"] = sql[index+1]["out_device"]
                    sql[index+1]["out_time"] = None
            
                if data["custom_is_cross_day"] == 1 and data["in_time"] is not None and data["out_time"] is None:
                    
                    data["out_time"] = sql[index+1]["out_time"]
                    sql[index+1]["out_time"] = None
                
                if not data.get("in_time") and data.get("out_time") and data.get("custom_cross_days") == 1:
                    data["out_time"] = ''
                    
                if not data.get("in_time") and not data.get("out_time"):
                    continue
            except Exception as e:
                msg = str(e)

        
            if data.get("in_time"):
                data["in_time"] = frappe.utils.get_timedelta(frappe.utils.format_time(data.get("in_time"), "HH:mm"))
            if data.get("out_time"):
                data["out_time"] = frappe.utils.get_timedelta(frappe.utils.format_time(data.get("out_time"), "HH:mm"))
            """ Fetching grade wise Present, Absent, HalfDay, late entry and early chekout Threshold """
            grade_emp = None
            if data["grade"]:
                grade_emp = frappe.get_doc("Employee Grade", data["grade"])
            
            if grade_emp:        
                #full_day = frappe.utils.get_time(grade_emp.custom_working_hours_threshold_for_present_hrs)
                #half_day = frappe.utils.get_time(grade_emp.custom_working_hours_threshold_for_half_day_hrs)
                #absent = frappe.utils.get_time(grade_emp.custom_working_hours_threshold_for_absent_hrs)
                if grade_emp.custom_check_in_grace_time is not None:
                    fifteen_minutes_in = frappe.utils.get_time(grade_emp.custom_check_in_grace_time) or frappe.utils.get_time("00:00:00")
                if grade_emp.custom_check_out_grace_time is not None:
                    fifteen_minutes_out = frappe.utils.get_time(grade_emp.custom_check_out_grace_time) or frappe.utils.get_time("00:00:00")
                late_count_threshold = grade_emp.custom_allowed_late_count_days or 0
            
            
            """SHIFT START TIME AND END TIME FULL DAY HALF DAY ABSENT THRESHOLD"""
            
            st = None
            et = None
            if data["shift"]:
                shift = frappe.get_doc("Shift Type", data["shift"])
                full_day = frappe.utils.get_time(shift.custom_working_hours_threshold_for_present)
                half_day = frappe.utils.get_time(shift.custom_working_hours_threshold_for_half_day)
                absent = frappe.utils.get_time(shift.custom_working_hours_threshold_for_absent)
                st = shift.start_time
                et = shift.end_time
            
            
            #st = frappe.db.get_value("Shift Type", data["shift"], "start_time")
            #et = frappe.db.get_value("Shift Type", data["shift"], "end_time")
            data["shift_start_time"] = st
            data["shift_end_time"] = et
            shift_type = ""
            if data["shift"]:
                shift_type = frappe.get_doc("Shift Type", data["shift"])
            
            """ Handling across days shifts / night shift """
            
            
        
                    
            """ Marking Attendance and Checkin """
            
            hours = frappe.utils.get_timedelta("00:00:00")
            try:    
                if data["out_time"] is None and data["in_time"] is None:
                    data["attendance"] = "Missing In and Out"
                elif data["in_time"] is None and data["out_time"]:
                    data["attendance"] = "Missing In"
                elif data["out_time"] is None and data["in_time"]:
                    data["attendance"] = "Missing Out"
                elif data["out_time"] is None:
                    data["attendance"] = "Missing Out"
                elif data["out_time"] < data.get("in_time") and data["custom_is_cross_day"] != 1:
                    data["attendance"] = "Invalid Punch"
                elif data["out_time"] > data["in_time"]:
                    hours = data["out_time"] - data["in_time"]
                    data["worked_hours"] = hours
                    if frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= full_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Present"
                    elif full_day >= frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= half_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                    elif frappe.utils.get_time(hours) < half_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Absent"
                        
                elif data["out_time"] < data["in_time"] and data["custom_is_cross_day"] == 1:
                    twenty_four_hour = frappe.utils.get_timedelta("24:00:00")
                    hours = data["out_time"] + twenty_four_hour - data["in_time"]
                    data["worked_hours"] = hours
                    if frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= full_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Present"
                    elif full_day >= frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= half_day:
                        
                        #frappe.log_error('data["date"]', data["date"])    
                        data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                    elif frappe.utils.get_time(hours) < half_day:
                        data["attendance"] = "Absent"
            except Exception as e:
                msg=e
                #frappe.log_error("Biometric Attendance Summary", msg)
                data["attendance"] = "Invalid Punch"
            
            """ Fetching week off and holidays """
            
            holiday_sql = frappe.db.sql(f"""
                SELECT
                    (CASE WHEN h.weekly_off = 0 THEN "HO" ELSE "WO" END) AS holiday,
                    -- (CASE WHEN h.weekly_off = 1 THEN "HO" ELSE 0 END) AS w_off,
                    h.holiday_date
                FROM
                    `tabHoliday List` hl
                LEFT JOIN
                    `tabHoliday` h ON hl.name = h.parent
                WHERE
                    hl.name = '{data.get("holiday_list")}'
                    AND h.holiday_date = '{data.get("date")}'
                GROUP BY
                    h.holiday_date
            """, as_dict = True)
                    
            
            if holiday_sql:
                for h in holiday_sql:
                    try:
                        if str(h["holiday_date"]) == str(data.get("date")) and h["holiday"]:
                            
                            if data.get("attendance") == "Present" and h["holiday"] == "HO":
                                data["attendance"] = "POH"
                            elif data.get("attendance") == "Present" and h["holiday"] == "WO":
                                data["attendance"] = "POW"
                            #else:
                             #   status[str(h["holiday_date"])] = h["holiday"]
                    except Exception as e:
                        msg = e
                    
            """ Marking Late Chekin """
            #if data.get("in_time") and data.get("out_time"):
            if not data.get("attendance") in ("POH", "POW", "Not Present", "Half Day"):
                if data.get("date") not in late_list:
                    late_count = frappe.db.get_value("Employee Grade", data["grade"], "custom_allowed_late_count_days") or 3
                    
                    if data["shift_start_time"] and data["in_time"]:
                        if str(data["date"]) > first_day_last_month:
                            
                            late_entry_difference = data["in_time"] - data["custom_actual_start_time"]
                            late_entry_difference_seconds = late_entry_difference.total_seconds()
                            f_seconds = fifteen_minutes_in.hour * 3600 + fifteen_minutes_in.minute * 60 + fifteen_minutes_in.second
                            
                            
                            if 0 < late_entry_difference_seconds < f_seconds :
                                #frappe.log_error("yes1", {"late_count": late_count, "len": len(consecutive_late_entries), "in": data["in_time"], "format_date": data["date"], "data": data})
                                data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                                employee = str(data["employee"]) + str(data["date"]) 
                                date = data["date"]
                                
                                if employee not in consecutive_late_entries:
                                    
                                    if not data.get("attendance") in ("Absent", "Missing In", "Missing Out", "Missing In and Out") or data.get("attendance") == "POH" or data.get("attendance") == "POW":
                                        consecutive_late_entries[employee] = consecutive_late_entries.get(employee, 0) + 1
                                        """if str(data["date"]) == "2024-08-06":
                                            #frappe.log_error("yes", frappe.utils.format_time(data["in_time"], "HH:mm"))"""
                                    #consecutive_late_entries[date] = consecutive_late_entries.get(date, 0) + 1
                                    if len(consecutive_late_entries) > late_count:
                                        if absent > frappe.utils.get_time(hours) > frappe.utils.get_time("00:00:00"):
                                            data["attendance"] = "Absent"
                                        elif data["out_time"] is None and data["in_time"]:
                                            data["attendance"] = "Missing Out"
                                        else:
                                            data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                                            
                            
                            elif late_entry_difference_seconds > f_seconds:
                                if data.get("attendance") not in ("Absent", "Missing Out", "Missing In", "Missing In and Out", "Invalid Punch", "None", None): 
                                
                                    if data["in_time"] and data["out_time"]:
                                        data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                                        data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                                    if frappe.utils.get_timedelta("00:00:00") < hours < frappe.utils.get_timedelta(str(absent)):
                                        data["attendance"] = "Absent"
                                        data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                                
                                #elif data["in_time"]:
                                #    data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                                    
                            else:
                                data["late_entry"] = "No"
                                #consecutive_late_entries[data["employee"]] = 0
                late_list.append(data['date'])
                
            
            """ Marking Early Checkout """
            
            if data["shift_end_time"] and data["out_time"]:
                early_exit_difference = data["shift_end_time"] - data["out_time"]
                early_exit_difference_seconds = early_exit_difference.total_seconds()
                f_seconds = fifteen_minutes_out.hour * 3600 + fifteen_minutes_out.minute * 60 + fifteen_minutes_out.second
                if early_exit_difference_seconds > f_seconds :
                    data["early_exit"] = "Yes"
                else:
                    data["early_exit"] = "No"
        
            """Checking in area and out area"""
            if data["in_area"] and data["out_area"]:
                if data["in_area"] != data["out_area"]:
                    data["area_change"] = "Yes"
                if data["in_area"] == data["out_area"]:

            if str(data["date"]) != first_day_next_month and str(data["date"]) != first_day_last_month:

    else:

    res["deducted_amount"] = amt_to_deduct
    res["salary_advance"] = amt_to_deduct
    
    result.append(res)

                leave_type = 'Compensatory Off'

                AND docstatus = 1
            ORDER BY
                from_date ASC
        """, (employee_code, from_date, to_date), as_dict=True)
    
    split_leave_applications = []
    for leave in leave_applications:
        total_days = leave["total_leave_days"]
        while total_days > 0:
            new_entry = leave.copy()
            new_entry["total_leave_days"] = min(0.5, total_days)
            leave_data = {

                'modified': frappe.format_value(new_entry.get('modified'), {"fieldtype": "Date"}),
                'italic': 1,
                'mark_utilsed': 0
            }
            split_leave_applications.append(leave_data)
            total_days = total_days - 0.5
    split_leave_applications = sorted(split_leave_applications, key=lambda x: x['from_date'])
    split_leave_dict = {}
    for i in split_leave_applications:
        if i['leave_id'] not in split_leave_dict:
            split_leave_dict[i['leave_id']] = i['credit']
        else: 
            split_leave_dict[i['leave_id']] = split_leave_dict[i['leave_id']] + i['credit']
            
    for emp in employee_data[employee_code]:
        result.append(emp)
        last_emp_index = len(result) - 1
        total_debit = 0
        if filters.get('show_details') == 1:
            total_credit = emp['credit']
            total_debit = 0
            for i, rec in enumerate(split_leave_applications):
                if rec['mark_utilsed'] == 0 and total_debit < total_credit:
                    if rec['leave_id'] == result[-1].get('leave_id', False):
                        # frappe.log_error("Result Map 2",{"Split": float(rec['credit'][1:])})
                        #try:
                        result[-1]['credit'] = float(split_leave_applications[i-1]['credit'][1:]) +  float(rec['credit'][1:])
                        
                    else:
                        result.append(rec)
                        
                    rec['mark_utilsed'] = 1
                    total_debit = total_debit + rec['debit']
        emp['utilised'] = total_debit
        emp['balance_credit'] = emp['credit'] - emp['utilised']
        result[last_emp_index] = emp

def get_from_to_dates(month: str, year: int):
    # Month mapping and days (non-leap year base)
    month_order = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
                   'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
    month_days = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30,
                  31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]

    def is_leap_year(y):
        return (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0) or (y % 400 == 0)

    # Update Feb if leap year
    if is_leap_year(year):
        month_days[1] = 29
        

    if month not in month_order:
        return {'error': 'Invalid month abbreviation'}

    curr_index = month_order.index(month)

    # Get from_date (last day of previous month)
    if curr_index == 0:  # January
        from_month_index = 11
        from_year = year - 1
    else:
        from_month_index = curr_index - 1
        from_year = year

    from_day = month_days[from_month_index]
    from_date = f"{from_year}-{from_month_index + 1:02d}-{from_day:02d} 00:00:00"

    # Get to_date (first day of next month)
    if curr_index == 11:  # December
        to_month_index = 0
        to_year = year + 1
    else:
        to_month_index = curr_index + 1
        to_year = year

    to_date = f"{to_year}-{to_month_index + 1:02d}-01 23:59:59"

    return {
        "from_date": from_date,
        "to_date": to_date,
        "first_day_last_month": from_date[:10],
        "first_day_next_month": to_date[:10]
    }

def get_from_to_dates(month: str, year: int):
    # Month mapping and days (non-leap year base)
    month_order = [
        "Jan",
        "Feb",
        "Mar",
        "Apr",
        "May",
        "Jun",
        "Jul",
        "Aug",
        "Sep",
        "Oct",
        "Nov",
        "Dec",
    ]
    month_days = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]

    def is_leap_year(y):
        return (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0) or (y % 400 == 0)

    # Update Feb if leap year
    if is_leap_year(year):
        month_days[1] = 29

    if month not in month_order:
        return {"error": "Invalid month abbreviation"}

    curr_index = month_order.index(month)

    # Get from_date (last day of previous month)
    if curr_index == 0:  # January
        from_month_index = 11
        from_year = year - 1
    else:
        from_month_index = curr_index - 1
        from_year = year

    from_day = month_days[from_month_index]
    from_date = f"{from_year}-{from_month_index + 1:02d}-{from_day:02d} 00:00:00"

    # Get to_date (first day of next month)
    if curr_index == 11:  # December
        to_month_index = 0
        to_year = year + 1
    else:
        to_month_index = curr_index + 1
        to_year = year

    to_date = f"{to_year}-{to_month_index + 1:02d}-01 23:59:59"

    return {
        "from_date": from_date,
        "to_date": to_date,
        "first_day_last_month": from_date[:10],
        "first_day_next_month": to_date[:10],
    }

def get_month_dates(month: str, year: int):
    month_days = {
        "Jan": {"from_date": "01-01", "to_date": "01-31"},
        "Feb": {"from_date": "02-01", "to_date": "02-28"},
        "Mar": {"from_date": "03-01", "to_date": "03-31"},
        "Apr": {"from_date": "04-01", "to_date": "04-30"},
        "May": {"from_date": "05-01", "to_date": "05-31"},
        "Jun": {"from_date": "06-01", "to_date": "06-30"},
        "Jul": {"from_date": "07-01", "to_date": "07-31"},
        "Aug": {"from_date": "08-01", "to_date": "08-31"},
        "Sep": {"from_date": "09-01", "to_date": "09-30"},
        "Oct": {"from_date": "10-01", "to_date": "10-31"},
        "Nov": {"from_date": "11-01", "to_date": "11-30"},
        "Dec": {"from_date": "12-01", "to_date": "12-31"},
    }

    month_order = list(month_days.keys())

    # Handle leap year for February
    def is_leap_year(y):
        return (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0) or (y % 400 == 0)

    if is_leap_year(year):
        month_days["Feb"]["to_date"] = "02-29"

    if month not in month_days:
        return {"error": "Invalid month name"}

    # from_date and to_date
    fr_date = f"{year}-{month_days[month]['from_date']} 00:00:00"
    t_date = f"{year}-{month_days[month]['to_date']} 23:59:59"

    # first_day_last_month
    first_day_last_month = f"{year}-{month_days[month]['from_date']}"

    # first_day_next_month
    month_index = month_order.index(month)
    if month == "Dec":
        next_month = "Jan"
        next_year = year + 1
    else:
        next_month = month_order[month_index + 1]
        next_year = year

    first_day_next_month = f"{next_year}-{month_days[next_month]['from_date']}"

    return {
        "from_date": fr_date,
        "to_date": t_date,
        "first_day_last_month": first_day_last_month,
        "first_day_next_month": first_day_next_month,
    }

def get_from_to_dates(month: str, year: int):
    # Month mapping and days (non-leap year base)
    month_order = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
                   'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
    month_days = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30,
                  31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]

    def is_leap_year(y):
        return (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0) or (y % 400 == 0)

    # Update Feb if leap year
    if is_leap_year(year):
        month_days[1] = 29

    if month not in month_order:
        return {'error': 'Invalid month abbreviation'}

    curr_index = month_order.index(month)

    # Get from_date (last day of previous month)
    if curr_index == 0:  # January
        from_month_index = 11
        from_year = year - 1
    else:
        from_month_index = curr_index - 1
        from_year = year

    from_day = month_days[from_month_index]
    from_date = f"{from_year}-{from_month_index + 1:02d}-{from_day:02d} 00:00:00"

    # Get to_date (first day of next month)
    if curr_index == 11:  # December
        to_month_index = 0
        to_year = year + 1
    else:
        to_month_index = curr_index + 1
        to_year = year

    to_date = f"{to_year}-{to_month_index + 1:02d}-01 23:59:59"

    return {
        "from_date": from_date,
        "to_date": to_date,
        "first_day_last_month": from_date[:10],
        "first_day_next_month": to_date[:10]
    }
